description: Defines options structures for various activation modules in the torch::nn namespace, including ELU, SELU, GLU, GELU, Hardshrink, Hardtanh, LeakyReLU, Softmax, Softmin, LogSoftmax, PReLU, ReLU, ReLU6, RReLU, CELU, Softplus, Softshrink, Threshold, GumbelSoftmax, and MultiheadAttention. Contains class definitions, option configurations, and related documentation.

classes.name: ELUOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the ELU activation module, including alpha and inplace parameters.

classes.name: SELUOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the SELU activation module, including inplace parameter.

classes.name: GLUOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the GLU activation module, including dimension parameter.

classes.name: GELUOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the GELU activation module, including approximation method.

classes.name: HardshrinkOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the Hardshrink activation, including lambda parameter.

classes.name: HardtanhOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the Hardtanh activation, including min_val, max_val, and inplace.

classes.name: LeakyReLUOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for LeakyReLU, including negative_slope and inplace.

classes.name: SoftmaxOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Softmax, including dimension.

classes.name: SoftmaxFuncOptions
classes.description: Functional options for Softmax, including dimension and optional dtype.

classes.name: SoftminOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Softmin, including dimension.

classes.name: SoftminFuncOptions
classes.description: Functional options for Softmin, including dimension and optional dtype.

classes.name: LogSoftmaxOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for LogSoftmax, including dimension.

classes.name: LogSoftmaxFuncOptions
classes.description: Functional options for LogSoftmax, including dimension and optional dtype.

classes.name: PReLUOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for PReLU, including num_parameters and init.

classes.name: ReLUOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for ReLU, including inplace.

classes.name: ReLU6Options
classes.description: Configuration options for ReLU6, including inplace.

classes.name: RReLUOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for RReLU, including lower, upper, and inplace.

classes.name: RReLUFuncOptions
classes.description: Functional options for RReLU, including lower, upper, training, and inplace.

classes.name: CELUOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for CELU, including alpha and inplace.

classes.name: SoftplusOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Softplus, including beta and threshold.

classes.name: SoftplusFuncOptions
classes.description: Functional options for Softplus, same as SoftplusOptions.

classes.name: SoftshrinkOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Softshrink, including lambda.

classes.name: SoftshrinkFuncOptions
classes.description: Functional options for Softshrink, same as SoftshrinkOptions.

classes.name: ThresholdOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Threshold, including threshold, value, and inplace.

classes.name: ThresholdFuncOptions
classes.description: Functional options for Threshold, same as ThresholdOptions.

classes.name: GumbelSoftmaxFuncOptions
classes.description: Functional options for Gumbel Softmax, including tau, hard, and dim.

classes.name: MultiheadAttentionOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for MultiheadAttention module, including embed_dim, num_heads, dropout, bias, add_bias_kv, add_zero_attn, kdim, vdim.

classes.name: MultiheadAttentionForwardFuncOptions
classes.description: Functional options for multi-head attention forward pass, including various tensors and parameters.
